metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the sword on the nail, eleven for Hamnet's return, and Anne's sentence on the forsworn gentlemen.

yesterday: Tomorrow morning is the leave. The sword stays off the school lane. Hamnet is back at eleven.
Richard has the cord. The description of the knot was taken back.
Mistress Ansell's opinion was delivered. Anne's answer is that the ladies were right to make them wait, and a twelvemonth was short.
The sixty shillings are still in the canvas.
